snippet.title: Warframe | Wake Up, Tenno (featuring Werner Herzog)
snippet.description:
Warframe is many things to many players (whom we call Tenno).

Clad in armor of untold power, they cycle between war and grace in a solar system paralyzed by conflict. Always adapting, evolving, becoming more.

Enemies abound here, from footsoldiers to sprawling leviathans. They will fight you on land, through the skies and in the stars above. Even beyond in the great unknown.

But with your Arsenal, your Abilities, and your potential, there's nothing that can stop you.

Once you begin following the guidance of the Lotus, you'll find vast worlds to explore, hundreds of weapons to master and unlimited ways to express yourself. With 13+ years of cinematic story expansions and content updates, starting your journey might feel daunting. But with a supportive community comprised of millions of Tenno just like you, there's no limit to what you can achieve together.

Wake up and play free now on all major platforms.

►► For more information, visit https://warframe.com.
